result.summary: Qwen2.5-VL 是 Qwen 视觉语言系列的最新旗舰模型，在视觉识别、目标定位、文档解析和长视频理解等方面取得进展 [abstract]。该模型采用原生动态分辨率 ViT 与 Window Attention，并引入动态 FPS 采样和绝对时间编码，可处理不同尺寸图像和长达数小时的视频 [abstract]。模型提供 72B、7B、3B 三种规模，旗舰 72B 在文档和图表理解上可与 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 匹敌，较小模型也优于同类竞品 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文指出当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.

method.text: Qwen2.5-VL 整体架构由大语言模型、视觉编码器和基于 MLP 的视觉-语言融合模块三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1]。视觉编码器重新设计 ViT，采用 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。模型引入动态 FPS 训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
only four layers employ full self-attention, while the remaining layers utilize windowed attention with a maximum window size of 112×112
Qwen2.5-VL incorporates dynamic frame rate (FPS) training and absolute time encoding.
Qwen2.5-VL introduces a key improvement: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time.

experiments.text: 论文在多种基准上评估 Qwen2.5-VL，并与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等模型比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及 GUI 智能体等任务 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。视频评估中每段视频最多分析 768 帧，视频 token 总数不超过 24,576 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
We evaluated our models across a diverse range of OCR, chart, and document understanding benchmarks.
We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL’s grounding capabilities on the referring expression comprehension benchmarks
We assessed our models across a diverse range of video understanding and grounding tasks
We assess the agent capabilities of Qwen2.5-VL through various aspects.
we capped the maximum number of frames analyzed per video at 768, with the total number of video tokens not exceeding 24,576.

findings.text: Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。在文档与 OCR 相关基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 CC-OCR 和 OmniDocBench 上创下新最优，并在 OCRBench_v2 上分别以英文和中文赛道超出 Gemini 1.5-Pro 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p2][S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。在视频定位任务 Charades-STA 上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 50.9 的 mIoU，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。在 GUI 智能体基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 ScreenSpot Pro 上取得 43.6% 准确率，远超 Aguvis-72B 的 23.6% 和 Qwen2-VL-72B 的 1.6% [S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU. For MMMU-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1
Qwen2.5-VL-72B model sets the new state-of-the-art due to curated training data and excellent capability of LLM models.
largely exceeding best model Gemini 1.5-Pro by 9.6% and 20.6% for English and Chinese track respectively.
Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%).

limitations.text: 论文在讨论拒绝采样中的思维链推理时指出，视觉语言模型依赖文本和视觉两种模态，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管采取了过滤策略，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
achieving optimal modality alignment remains an ongoing challenge that requires further advancements.
